## Design Settings » Main Menu Design
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000045049

## Main Menu Design
This article goes over the Main Menu Design settings and how to edit the Main Menu of the website. To access this section navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
General
Main Menu Design

## 3. Public Visitor Main Menu
This setting controls the menu displayed for visitors of the website, visitors being people viewing the website without logging in. Very important to note that only the default or an exact clone of the Header Main Menu is going to work on this area. Other Menus listed on Toolbox >> Menu Manager are not going to work since these are not designed for this area.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169005503/original/xnMERYGJIqDktNXm4Pdjtacf8xdysTdHWw.png?1760501220 | alt: ]

## 4. Logged In Member Main Menu
This setting controls the Members Main Menu, which will only be displayed when members are logged in to the website. Very important to note that only the default or an exact clone of the Header Main Menu is going to work on this area. Other Menus listed on Toolbox >> Menu Manager are not going to work since these are not designed for this area.
Use this Menu option to add links just for members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169005508/original/XLf4JU0TJOX41FSbUOES0vO6GAspSeiIJw.png?1760501249 | alt: ]

These setting control the colors of the website's Main Menu.
